effect: Starts the one 8-player battle; there are no menus, modes, passwords or CPU players
note: $256 waits for bit 7 of $2F4 (the first pad found); then $3BC sets up the arena. Not in GameFAQs or other published notes

code: Sega Team Player in both ports
effect: Players 1-8 each on their own pad
note: Team Player protocol only ($30A0, ID $73/$3F, port 1 then port 2). BizHawk GPGX ControlType 4 on both ports: P1-P8 each moved players 1-8 (players.lua)

code: Fewer pads (plain pads, one Team Player)
effect: Pads are packed in order: player n is the nth pad found
note: Empty sockets and mice store nothing ($31D2 table). Two pads: players 1-2; Team Player + pad: players 1-5. Players without a pad stand still

code: A on your own bomb (with Line Bomb)
effect: Lays all remaining bombs in a line ahead
note: $20F6, needs item $14 (+$28). With 4 bombs, 3 were laid in the 3 free cells ahead (powers.lua)

effect: Sends the bomb sliding
note: $168C sets the bomb to the sliding routine $22D2; seen moving one step before a brick stopped it (powers.lua)

effect: Unused item: counted on pickup, no effect
note: Never placed ($3554 table); pickup adds 1 to player +$26 ($15DE), which nothing reads. Graphic: a bomb with a yellow lightning bolt (remote control? a guess). Forced onto the floor and walked over: only +$26 changed (items.lua)

effect: Same 16 cleared bricks and the same 65 hidden items on every boot
note: Constant seed $27DE ($434). 27 bomb up, 27 fire up, 7 kick, 4 line bomb (itemmap.lua); arenas pixel-equal with Start on different frames

effect: Static: the clock stays 2:00, no round end or winner
note: Part of the arena picture, no code updates them; unchanged after 70 s, and with all 8 dead the empty arena stays (idle.lua). Reset to play again

effect: A song-break call the game never makes, and three sound effects it never plays: two short ticks and a bell-like ping
note: $D8140 plays song 3 for $180 frames then returns; nothing calls it. Effects go through $D8010, called only with 1, 2, 4 and 6 ($1618, $1B28, $215A/$218E/$21F0, $2FF0). Entries 7-9 of the table at $DA1D2 have sequences of their own ($DAB56, $DAB6E, $DAB8A): 7 is a 2-frame PSG tick (about 4 kHz, then 1.2 kHz), 8 the same two notes reversed, 9 an FM ping of about 0.8 s. 7 and 8 have no waits, so they last 2-3 frames. Played in BizHawk in a battle with the music held, each entry written into its channel the way $D81EC does.

effect: Development leftovers, unreferenced
note: $212 writes the interrupt addresses into the vector table ($78/$70, only possible from RAM, e.g. a dev kit); $280 blanks the display and executes ILLEGAL ($4AFC)

effect: Game hangs
note: $1F8A: bra.b $1F92 forever; 8 players plus bombs and fires normally stay below it

effect: The 4 line bombs under bricks become the unused item $13 (Game Genie)
note: item table $3562: $14 -> $13. BizHawk client.addcheat: hidden items $13 x4 instead of $14 x4. Pro Action Replay 003562:0013: the same ROM word; BizHawk, the word written to MD CART every frame (its Lua addcheat takes Genesis Action Replay codes for RAM only): hidden items $13 x4 instead of $14 x4.

effect: Every player starts with kick (Game Genie)
note: $14C4 clr.w $24(a3) -> addq.w #1. Player 1 +$24 = 1 at the start. Pro Action Replay 0014C4:526B: the same ROM word; BizHawk, the word written to MD CART every frame (its Lua addcheat takes Genesis Action Replay codes for RAM only): player 1 +$24 = 1.

effect: Every player starts with line bomb (Game Genie)
note: $14CC clr.w $28(a3) -> addq.w #1. Player 1 +$28 = 1. Pro Action Replay 0014CC:526B: the same ROM word; BizHawk, the word written to MD CART every frame (its Lua addcheat takes Genesis Action Replay codes for RAM only): player 1 +$28 = 1.

effect: Start with fire 8 (Game Genie)
note: $14E2 = 8 (was 2). Player 1 +$22 = 8. Pro Action Replay 0014E2:0008: the same ROM word; BizHawk, the word written to MD CART every frame (its Lua addcheat takes Genesis Action Replay codes for RAM only): player 1 +$22 = 8.

effect: Start with 8 bombs (Game Genie)
note: $14E8 = 8 (was 1). Player 1 +$20 = 8. Pro Action Replay 0014E8:0008: the same ROM word; BizHawk, the word written to MD CART every frame (its Lua addcheat takes Genesis Action Replay codes for RAM only): player 1 +$20 = 8.

effect: CPU-time meter: backdrop red, 16 nops, back to black
note: $30C (unreferenced). Nothing calls it (static map plus coverage of boot and 3000 frames of 8-pad play)

effect: Unused sliding-bomb start that also resets the fuse to 150 and snaps to the cell grid
note: The kick code sets the slide routine $22D2 directly; nothing references $22A4

effect: Three cut item panels: a skull and blue panels numbered 6 and 7
note: They follow the five real items in the arena tiles (resource $2031C, tiles from $203A2; the skull at file $20642). A cell's tile is its item number, and items come only from the brick table $3554 ($10, $11, $12, $14) and the death drop at $1BEC-$1DEC; the pickup code $15B6-$15F2 knows only $10-$14, and no other cell write or sprite names $15-$17. The numbered panels look like stand-ins for items 6 and 7. Written into a cell the game's own way in BizHawk, all three show on the floor.

effect: A full set of clock digits, of which the stopped clock only ever shows 2 and 0
note: The HUD graphics (resource $18892, block +$8A, loaded to VRAM $7400 by $0D02) hold digits 0-9 as tiles 32-41 (1-9 at file $18D3C-$18E5C). The HUD map (+$C8A, drawn by $0D74) uses only tiles 10-15, 26-32, 34 and 42-95, and no code names the others, because the clock never runs. Image: 1 and 3-9 in the HUD palette.
